title: Yellowed Kenyan Muffin Wrap
description: A lazy Sunday Kenyan dish featuring muffins, pickle, and a pandan leaf wrap, with a resinous and glassy-jelly texture, perfect for a low-carb friendly meal. This dish is a unique twist on traditional Kenyan cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Wrap each muffin in a pandan leaf, making sure to seal the edges.
Place the wrapped muffins on a baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes.
While the muffins are baking, mix the cream cheese, chopped scallions, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
After the muffins have baked, let them cool for a few minutes.
Spread a tablespoon of the cream cheese mixture on each muffin.
Top each muffin with a spoonful of chopped pickle.
Serve the muffin wraps warm and enjoy.
